# Viva Facility Services Private Limited

Viva Facility Services Private Limited is a Non-govt company, incorporated on 13 Jul, 2010. It's a private unlisted company and is classified as'company limited by shares'. Company's authorized capital stands at Rs 1.0 lakhs and has 100.0% paid-up capital which is Rs 1.0 lakhs. Viva Facility Services Private Limited last annual general meet (AGM) happened on 30 Sep, 2017. The company last updated its financials on 31 Mar, 2017 as per Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA). Viva Facility Services Private Limited is majorly in Business Services business from last 16 years and currently, company operations are active. Current board members & directors are MANISHA ANIL MOHITE and MARUTI BHIMRAO WAGRALKAR . Company is registered in Mumbai (Maharashtra) Registrar Office. Viva Facility Services Private Limited registered address is SHOP NO 80, KAWALI COMPOUND, N.M. JOSHI MARG OPP RAILWAY WORKSHOP, LOWER PAREL, MUMBAI MH 400013 IN.
